entries.name: WarpShaders.metallib
entries.role: Spatial computing / XR compositor and spatial media shaders
entries.note: Spatial computing shader of an Apple XR compositor or spatial media stack; BifrOSt has no XR hardware or compositor to run it.

entries.name: WeatherMapsMetalLib.metallib
entries.role: Effects shader of WeatherMaps (app or system UI animation)
entries.note: Copy of the iOS-compatibility (iOSSupport) framework resources for running iPad and iPhone apps on Mac. BifrOSt runs no iOS apps; the same kernel is covered by the matching /System/Library row.
